name: typeform
description: Connect Typeform to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Typeform MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Typeform to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with forms and responses using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Typeform workspace.
Find anything in Typeform that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review forms and responses in Typeform.
